conbody.p: A concept section is recognized by a descriptive or noun-phrase heading such as "Print Quality," "Connection Modes," or "How the Print Spooler Works," paired with a body of explanatory paragraphs, definition tables, or comparison tables. No ordered list as the dominant body structure.
When these signals align, the converter generates a:

ul.li:
The opening paragraph maps to and subsequent paragraphs map to

inside .
Tables in a concept topic always map to <simpletable> unless a <caption> element or merged cells are present, in which case the table routes to a CALS <table>.
A 2-column table in a concept topic never maps to <properties> — that element is only generated in a Reference topic with an API keyword context.
